title: ghul ye koofe me tha khuda hafiz
body:
ghul ye koofe me tha khuda hafiz
sab namazi ye kehte hai rokar
ahlebaite nabi ye kehte hai
aaj binte nabi ke pyaaro ke
<<DIVIDER>>
lab pa hai ye sada khuda hafiz
zainabe qastajaa'n ye kehti thi
baba jaa'n apka khuda hafiz
ae 'himayat' ye kehte hai shia
<<DIVIDER>>
sab ba aaho buka khuda hafiz
